messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: DETECTED: meter-emit backlog rising (eu-west-1). Symptom: delayed usage reports and transient overage flags. Severity: P2. Runbook: /runbooks/metering/ingest-backlog. Link: https://ops.redwood/incident/1799998881
amber_oncall: acked. joining bridge now. seeing customers pinging CS about overage emails.
sree: quick check - Kafka consumer lag spiking on consumer-group meter-ingest-eu. offsets ~+400k behind. binlogs show emitter restarts ~03:12Z.
liz_billing: getting multiple alert emails from billing rules about >threshold spikes in eu region customers. Can we temporarily suppress notifications while we triage?
omar_cs: CS already fielding 6 tickets, asked for shared status. We should post a short customer note if we plan suppression.
amber_oncall: suppressing automated overage emails for the eu rule now (billing-rule-eu-usage). liz, confirm when suppressed.
liz_billing: paused notifications. preparing a customer note template - keeping it vague: "We're investigating delayed usage reporting; your usage may appear inflated temporarily." Will hold send until we confirm mitigation plan.
sree: digging into consumer group. running consumer-lag check: ```
# kcat -b kafka-eu:9092 -G meter-ingest-eu meter-events --show-cursor
consumer-group: meter-ingest-eu lag: 412341 partitions stalled: 12
/var/logs/emitter.log: 2026-03-17T03:12:08Z emitter[pid=4412] restart reason: OOM
```
amber_oncall: deploy-bot, did we have a recent config change for emitter autoscaling?
deploy-bot: recent deploy 03:05Z to emitter service (rev b2f7). Autoscale policy unchanged. Canary passed. No infra config changes in eu after that.
sree: looks like an OOM-induced restart caused a backlog; downstream aggregator fell behind and counting duplicates on replay caused transient spikes in raw counts which triggered billing rules. We need to: 1) increase emitter consumer parallelism, 2) kick consumer restart with controlled replay, 3) run dedupe job for the affected window.
amber_oncall: plan sounds good. Who owns the dedupe job?
sree: I can patch consumer config and restart with lower parallelism first to allow steady catch-up. liz - can billing accept a short window suppression + credits if duplicates surface?
liz_billing: yes, we'll prepare a cleanup credit bucket for any customers who were overflagged. But we need a clear window and list of affected account IDs. Omar, can CS hold the tickets with that message?
omar_cs: yes, holding tickets and sending the template. ask Sree to post the affected account list to the incident doc when ready.
sree: running controlled restart now: ```
# ./scripts/consumer-restart --group meter-ingest-eu --parallelism 8 --max-batch 500
restarting consumer group... ok
```
amber_oncall: monitoring. Kafka lag dropping from 412k -> 180k in 6m. :thumbsup:
sree: lag trending down to ~12k. scheduling dedupe window job for 03:00Z-03:30Z, will post IDs in ~12m.
liz_billing: once IDs posted we'll suppress final billing run for that window and queue credits. also recommend a short post-incident email to customers.
amber_oncall: agreed. Amber -> creating incident bridge note and tagging stakeholders. If lag keeps decreasing, we'll move to recovery and then run validation before re-enabling alerts.
incident-bot: STATUS UPDATE: mitigations applied (consumer restart, notifications paused). Next update in 15m or on demand. Severity: P2 -> monitoring.
omar_cs: sending interim note to affected customers now.
amber_oncall: adding postmortem owners: sree (root cause & fixes), liz_billing (customer credits), omar_cs (comms).
amber_oncall: closing bridge for now, will re-open if regression. :eyes:
